div.head: Af El. 30
div.ab: Ða fæmnan þe gewuniað onfón gealdorcræftigan ⁊ scinlæcan ⁊ wiccan, ne læt þu ða libban.
Þa fæmnan ðe gewuniað ánfón galdorcræft ⁊ scinlæcan ⁊ wiccan, ne læt ðu ða libban
Ða fæmnan þe gewilniað onfon galdercræftigan and scinlacan and wiccan, ne læt þu hi libban.
Ða fæmnan þe gewuniað onfón gealdorcræftigan ⁊ scinlæcan ⁊ wiccan, ne læt þu ða libban.
Die Weiber, welche Beschwörer und Magier und Zauberer [hilfreich] aufzunehmen pflegen: lasse du die nicht leben.
The women who are accustomed to receive [helpfully] conjurers and magicians and sorcerers: do not let them live.
The women who are in the habit of receiving wizards and sorcerers and magicians, thou shalt not suffer to live.
Those women who are accustomed to receive enchanters and magicians and witches – do not permit them to live.
div.note: from Exodus xxii. 18, but only wizards are mentioned there.

note.seg: vielleicht nur u verlesen als il
perhaps merely u misread as il

Vgl. Gl Zauber 3f.; zur Häufung der Namen 1. Turk (Legal code 37) meint, Af verbinde hiermit die vorige Zeile der Vulg. quam [leicht verlesbar als quando] virgines accipere consueverunt maleficos, non patieris vivere: da man in der Vulg. die Verse noch nicht zählte und vielleicht falsch interpungierte, wohl möglich. Allein Af hat ähnlichen Relativsatz auch El 12 unterdrückt und straft Begünstiger (s. d. Gl 6b) dem Verbrecher gleich auch sonst; Af 4

Cf. Gl Zauber 3f.; on the accumulation of names 1. Turk (Legal code 37) thinks that Af connects with this the preceding line of the Vulg., quam [easily misread as quando] virgines accipere consueverunt maleficos, non patieris vivere: since the verses in the Vulg. were not yet numbered and were perhaps wrongly punctuated, this is quite possible. But Af also suppressed a similar relative clause in El 12, and elsewhere too punishes abettors (see that word in Gl 6b) equally with the criminal; Af 4
‘witches’ Schmid, but the gender is uncertain; Toller
